title: Wire StorageManager into ScanPipeline + launch-time trim hook (v1.1)

title: ResultView save state machine: unsaved/dirty/saving/saved with explicit Save button
description: Track explicit save state on the working ScanResult. Pipeline auto-persist sets state to unsaved (original saved, no edits). Each user edit transitions unsaved|saved -> dirty. Save button transitions dirty -> saving -> saved. TestCaseBundle export disabled in dirty state. editCount derived at save time = count(cells where userOverride != nil OR userAdded == true) + count(unplaced where action != .none). No event log.
notes: Spec: result-rendering §Save state machine. Design.md: D4. Tasks.md: 9.6.

title: Unplaced strip UI: thumbnails + place/edit/keep/discard actions
description: Add an Unplaced strip UI alongside the grid in ResultView when unplaced list is non-empty. Each item shows a cropped thumbnail of the source image around the bbox, payload (or '(no payload)'), and reason. Tap opens an action sheet: place at (row, col), edit payload, keep as outlier (row=-1,col=-1), discard (preserved in CSV with status=discarded).
notes: Spec: result-rendering §Unplaced strip UI. Design.md: D3. Tasks.md: 9.5.

title: Derived-cell view-model: load rawPayloads -> apply current regex -> re-run inference -> layer edits
description: Implement the derived-cell view-model that transforms a StoredScan into the displayable [GridCell] + unplaced lists. Steps: (1) load rawPayloads, (2) apply current validatorRegex from @AppStorage, (3) re-run grid inference using stored layoutMode, (4) layer edits (userOverride, userAdded, discarded). Result must match original-scan-time view when regex and tunables are unchanged.

title: StoredScan schema: derived-cell model (raw payloads + edits, validatorRegexAtCapture)
description: StoredScan persists rawPayloads (payload+bbox+confidence+rawBytes), edits (userOverride per cell, userAdded, discarded flags), validatorRegexAtCapture (immutable), and layoutMode. NOT cells. Cell statuses are derived on view by re-applying current regex + re-running grid inference. Enables regex changes to propagate to history without migration.
notes: Spec: scan-storage §Cells are derived. Design.md: D1. Tasks.md: 8.1. Supersedes scope of dms-1ni.5.

title: CSVExporter: add discarded provenance status for explicitly-discarded unplaced detections

title: ZXingObjC fallback decoder integration (deferred from bootstrap)
description: Bootstrap (dms-5c3.1) deferred ZXingObjC SPM integration because upstream zxingify-objc Package.swift declares unsafeFlags(['-fprofile-instr-generate']), which Swift Package Manager forbids when an iOS app target depends on the package directly. Options to evaluate: (1) vendor a local SPM wrapper package that re-exports a patched manifest without unsafe flags; (2) fork zxingify-objc and remove the unsafe flag; (3) use a different Data Matrix library; (4) drop ZXing fallback if Vision-only proves sufficient on the testbed corpus. Acceptance: BarcodeScanner can invoke a working ZXing path when Vision returns nil payloadStringValue, all callers compile, app target builds against iOS Simulator iPhone 16. See docs/vision-api-notes.md ZXingObjC Fallback section.
